items.title: Bring AWS Transform into GitHub Copilot with MCP
items.summary: Introduction If GitHub Copilot is already part of your .NET workflow, you know how much it accelerates day-to-day coding. Now you can bring the power of AWS Transform (ATX) directly into that same workflow through the AWS Transform MCP server. AWS Transform is an agentic AI service that analyzes and transforms whole applications, infrastructure, and […]
